life_stage: Adult ascetic sage in the Nara-Nārāyaṇa pair.

visual_bible.skin: Natural warm-brown human skin, not orange; skin-only patch red-minus-blue below 120.
visual_bible.face: Calm mature ascetic face, distinct from Mārkaṇḍeya and Nārāyaṇa.
visual_bible.hair: Dark hair bound in a modest ascetic topknot.
visual_bible.clothing: Plain cream and muted ochre ascetic garments with minimal ornament.
visual_bible.anatomy: One head, two attached arms and hands, two legs and feet; natural human proportions.
visual_bible.style: Flat matte mineral-color temple mural with firm dark contours and shallow decorative space.

depiction_rules.notes: Depict as the human ascetic companion beside blue-skinned Nārāyaṇa; do not duplicate either figure or conflate Nara with Markandeya.

never: no extra limbs or malformed hands or feet
no readable text, signature, logo or watermark
no glossy skin, metallic gold, cinematic rays or beams
